_README: HOW TO USE THIS FILE. JSONL has no comment syntax, so every line whose keys ALL start with '_' is a comment: ecvt/evals.py load_dataset() skips it. Lines 1-5 are the existing real cases (di-001..di-005). Below: a scoring guide, one fully worked example, then 7 drafts (di-006..di-012). To turn a draft into a real case: fill every TODO, then replace the whole line {"_draft": {...}} with just the inner {...}. Goal: 12 real cases, 0 '_draft' lines.

_SCORING_GUIDE: Pick the cheapest mode that can decide the property (course: Prompt evaluation > Code based grading vs Model based grading). (1) schema-valid: needs "expected_schema": "agents.a02_domain_intelligence.schema.DomainModel" (or ...DeclineTask). Passes iff the tool output validates. Use it for 'did it emit the right object'. (2) keyword-match: needs "expected_keywords": ["read_status", "not_specified"]. Passes iff EVERY string appears in the output text (case-insensitive). Use it for ids/enum values that must appear. (3) llm-judge: needs "rubric": "Pass iff ...". Use it only for meaning a parser cannot check. One rubric = one or a few checkable clauses joined by 'and'; never 'good', 'reasonable', 'complete'.
